title: Doordarshan
desc: When Darshan Kaur, the family matriarch, regains consciousness after decades, her son Sunil and his estranged wife Priya must bring back the 1980s to protect her from shock.

title: Niguda Atma
desc: A family's quiet life shatters into a living nightmare when a demonic entity claims their child as its vessel. Can demonologist Annamma help them survive this?

title: Choo Mantar
desc: Paranormal team explores haunted Morgan House for treasure, unaware of its dark history of greed, betrayal, and tragic deaths.

title: Hebbuli
desc: In order to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, Ram investigates the case but faces several obstacles as he attempts to fight against the corrupt system and protect his family.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda
desc: Shankar, an autorickshaw driver, adopts an abandoned dog and names it Gunda. However, his life turns upside down when his affection for the canine deepens.
